name: 2D Field Solver
description: Microstrip, embedded microstrip, edge-coupled, stripline, and CPW impedance with JLCPCB stackups.
description_full: Transmission-line calculator for PCB layout. Supports microstrip, embedded microstrip, edge-coupled microstrip, stripline, and conductor-backed coplanar waveguide. JLCPCB stackup presets fill dielectric constant, height, and finished copper. Opens in its own window from the PCB editor toolbar. A selected track width is loaded as W.
